name: slack
description: Work with Slack using the configured Slack integration.

interface.longDescription: Use Slack to summarize channels, draft messages, and organize team conversations through the connected Slack integration.
defaultPrompt: Summarize what mattered most in [channel] over the last 7 days and list decisions plus owners plus next steps
Draft a crisp reply in the same tone as the channel for the last customer escalation message in [channel]
Build a 30 minute meeting agenda based on the top themes from this mornings discussion in [channel]
